extraction.summary_en: This filing records decisions of the sole shareholder (associée unique) of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES dated 29 June 2018: allocation of the year's profit to legal reserve/other reserves, and replacement of the statutory auditor (GEREC replacing Richard Despratz). No capital increase, decrease, share transfer, or shareholder entry/exit is mentioned. The only capital figure (400 000 euros) appears solely in the document's letterhead and is not treated as a snapshot per instructions.

evidence.quote_fr: EXTRAIT DES DECISIONS DE L'ASSOCIEE UNIQUE EN DATE DU 29 JUIN 2018

issues: The letterhead states capital of 400 000 euros but per instructions this is not recorded as a snapshot since it derives from a letterhead statement, not a printed capital-table article.
